metadata.attribution: MAREA products by the authors of the MAREA project (see CITATION.cff in the repository), CC BY 4.0. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel-2 data processed in the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. Tide: EOT20 (Hart-Davis et al., 2021, Earth System Science Data 13, 3869-3884; CC BY 4.0) and, where stated, sea-level records of the IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility (VLIZ/IOC-UNESCO).
metadata.description: MAREA fits one tide delay per 3-km section of the distance through the water from the open sea (the image edge), smooths it along that distance and applies it to the whole tide curve. A line of equal delay joins the points the tide reaches the same number of minutes after the open sea.
metadata.drawn: Inside the intertidal mask cleaned by hand; lines of 20 m or more, simplified to 5 m. Pieces that reach the image edge run through the open sea, where the distance is not measured from the estuary mouth, and are left out.
metadata.title: Lines of equal delay
